sources.title: Un Ministral, des Ministraux
sources.evidence: October 16, 2024 announcement introduces original Ministral 3B and 8B and says both are available that day. Gives 128k context and function calling. Availability table assigns 3B the Mistral Commercial License; self-deployment requires commercial contact. Only 8B Instruct weights are released for research. The interleaved attention claim is explicitly for 8B.

sources.title: Ministral 3B — exact legacy model reference
sources.evidence: Identifies ministral-3b-2410, text input/output, 128k context and function calling. Records release October 9, 2024, conflicting with the October 16 availability announcement. Lists December 2025 deprecation/retirement and explicitly distinguishes replacement Ministral 3 3B. Read Markdown and corresponding rendered-page/catalog payload; original model has no linked weights.

sources.title: API changelog — original Ministral release
sources.evidence: Retrospective 2024 October 9 entry explicitly says Ministral 3B (ministral-3b-2410) and 8B were released. This is release language, not merely a model creation timestamp, but conflicts with the contemporaneous October 16 public-availability announcement. No separate contemporaneous October 9 public availability evidence was located.

sources.title: Ministral 1 - 3B — model lifecycle
sources.evidence: Lifecycle table labels original model Ministral 1 - 3B, general-purpose base, with October 9, 2024 release. Delivered page contains lifecycle information; technical-documentation tab content was not accessible in that response. No parameter count or architecture is disclosed there. Lifecycle Active status does not establish current API availability.

sources.title: Ministral-3B — pinned Qualcomm model card before deprecation
sources.evidence: October 2025 revision describes the original commercial on-device Ministraux implementation and explicitly lists Number of parameters: 3B. Assets require purchase and are unavailable for direct download because of licensing restrictions. Its 4096 context is the compiled-device deployment setting, not the original model maximum. Does not disclose exact learned-weight count, active count or internal architecture.

sources.title: Ministral-3B implementation metadata v0.40.0
sources.evidence: Official implementation metadata names Mistral AI as model maker and specifies nominal 3B parameters, commercial licensing, restricted model sharing and Contact For Purchase. Its source points to the generic mistral-inference library, not a public original-3B configuration. The tagged directory contains documentation/metadata, without a model configuration or weight tensors.

sources.title: Qualcomm and Mistral AI partner on original Ministral models
sources.evidence: October 23, 2024 announcement establishes the direct Mistral partnership for the newly launched commercial 3B and 8B on-device models. This corroborates the original-model identity of Qualcomm implementation documentation, independently of the later December 2025 Ministral 3 family.

sources.title: Original Ministral 8B Instruct model card — comparison check
sources.evidence: Card contains original 3B benchmark rows but its dense Transformer structure, 36 layers and exact parameter total are explicitly 8B specifications. It does not disclose original 3B architecture or active parameters; those sibling specifications are not transferred.

sources.title: Ministral 3 technical report — later-family check
sources.evidence: January 2026 report describes December 2025 Ministral 3 models, including their dense architecture, vision modules and new 3B/8B/14B variants. Its 3B configuration describes the successor, not ministral-3b-2410. It provides no exact original-3B active count or architecture disclosure used here.

sources.title: Original upstream catalog identity
sources.evidence: Current raw source dates this undated catalog ID to October 16, 2024 and links the original ministraux announcement and Azure Ministral-3B. This identifies the frozen record as original Ministral 3B, not Ministral 3 3B Instruct 2512; catalog technical claims are independently checked rather than accepted as evidence.

sources.title: Qualcomm repository metadata
sources.evidence: Current public repository at fa81f551e98ae8eab8196b6bfda726c487bd4fc6 contains only .gitattributes and README, with zero stored weight bytes. Its current README is a deprecation notice. Public metadata availability does not establish public model weights; the pinned earlier card explicitly documents restricted assets.

name.note: Retain original model name. Exact legacy API identifier is ministral-3b-2410; this is not the newer Ministral 3 3B Instruct 2512 checkpoint.

developer.note: Mistral AI is the original developer; retain normalized catalog label.

family.note: Original Ministral family, introduced as les Ministraux. Its 2024 generation remains distinct from the replacement Ministral 3 family.

release_date.note: Retain the contemporaneous public launch date: the dated October 16 announcement says both models are available that day. Later exact-model docs, API changelog and legal lifecycle instead specify October 9. That earlier date is an unresolved primary-source conflict; no independent contemporaneous public availability evidence for October 9 was located. This value denotes the documented public launch, not a proven reconciliation of those records.

open_weights.note: Correct unsupported open-weights flag. Original 3B distribution requires a commercial agreement; only original 8B research weights were publicly released in the launch. Qualcomm explicitly restricts asset sharing and requires purchase; its public documentation repository contains no weights.

license.note: Exact original 3B row names Mistral Commercial License. Do not transfer the 8B research license or successor Apache 2.0 license.

parameters_b.note: Official Mistral implementation partner explicitly gives Number of parameters: 3B for the original commercial model. This is a nominal whole-model disclosure, not an exact tensor census. No original checkpoint was publicly available to derive a complete learned-weight count; the newer multimodal 3B checkpoint count does not apply.

active_parameters_b.note: No separate active-parameter figure for original ministral-3b-2410 is disclosed in the checked exact documentation, implementation metadata or later comparison/technical sources. Do not equate nominal total with active count or import successor Active (B)=3.

architecture.note: Exact original 3B sources do not disclose dense versus MoE structure or an inspectable configuration. Launch interleaved attention and original 8B card architecture apply specifically to 8B; later dense Ministral 3 report describes another generation. Targeted original-model training and interpretability searches yielded no first-party architecture disclosure.

context_window.note: Developer specifies up to 128k. Preserve decimal catalog normalization 128000 as nominal capacity; an exact 128000 versus 131072 boundary is not established. Qualcomm 4096 is a compiled-device configuration and does not replace original model capacity.

modalities.note: Exact original API reference explicitly specifies text input and text output. Do not transfer vision support from its multimodal successor.

reasoning.note: Clear unsupported categorical false. Original launch discusses ordinary reasoning performance but does not explicitly classify a dedicated reasoning/thinking mode. No exact-original affirmative or negative mode statement was found; successor Instruct maintainer discussions do not establish original capability.

tool_call.note: Original launch describes function calling and exact dated model reference explicitly lists Function Calling.

description.value: Text model for on-device assistants and function-calling workflows, offered under a commercial license.
description.note: Use documented modalities, intended deployment, native tools and licensing; remove comparative efficiency claims.

patch.description: Text model for on-device assistants and function-calling workflows, offered under a commercial license.
patch.notes: Original October 2024 Ministral 3B (ministral-3b-2410), not the December 2025 multimodal Ministral 3 3B successor. Public launch is October 16, 2024; retrospective developer model docs, API changelog and legal lifecycle give October 9, an unresolved date conflict. Original weights require a commercial agreement and were not released openly. Qualcomm directly discloses nominal 3B parameters; exact total, active count and internal architecture remain undisclosed. Context is the developer's nominal 128k (128000 catalog normalization), not an independently verified exact token boundary. Dedicated reasoning mode is unverified. Legacy docs record December 2025 API retirement; they do not demonstrate current endpoint operation.

summary: Audited all 14 fields for original ministral-3b-2410. Correct open weights to false, establish Mistral Commercial License, promote nominal 3B count from model-name inference to direct implementation-partner evidence, and clear unverified reasoning=false. Retain text-only input/output, tools and nominal 128k context. Original architecture and active count remain undisclosed after exact and later-source checks. Keep October 16 documented public launch with explicit unresolved October 9 retrospective-source conflict. No successor checkpoint specifications or full weight downloads are used.
